test_spec.setup: t(a int,j json,index kj((cast(j as date array))))；插入(1,json_array(cast("2010-10-10" as date),cast("2010-10-10" as date)))。

test_spec.oracle: 相同谓词索引与扫描结果集合应一致；记录类型转换警告，不预设字符串必须匹配内部DATE值。
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标8.0支持JSON及多值索引，该差分用例可探索。

header.Bug #112147: Use/Ignore Mutil-value index for MEMBER OF function has differnet result

comments.author: Shenghui Wu
comments.text:
Description:
Use/Ignore Mutil-value index for MEMBER OF function has differnet result

How to repeat:
MySQL [test]> use test;
Database changed
MySQL [test]> create table t(a int, j json, index kj((cast(j as date array))));

Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.178 sec)

MySQL [test]> insert into t values(1, json_array(cast("2010-10-10" as date), cast("2010-10-10" as date)));
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.024 sec)

MySQL [test]> select * from t use index(kj) where "2010-10-10" member of(j);
+------+------------------------------+
| a    | j                            |
+------+------------------------------+
|    1 | ["2010-10-10", "2010-10-10"] |
+------+------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.000 sec)

MySQL [test]> select * from t ignore index(kj) where "2010-10-10" member of(j);
Empty set (0.000 sec)

comments.author: MySQL Verification Team
comments.text:
Hello Shenghui Wu,

Thank you for the report and test case.
Verified as described. 

regards,
Umesh

comments.author: Roy Lyseng
comments.text:
Workaround: Use a proper DATE literal value, such as in

  select * from t ignore index(kj) where DATE'2010-10-10' member of(j);
